Nora features a fairy-like face. She also has black hair and black eyes.

## History

Nora was one of [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) Stanhope's imaginary childhood companions residing near the shore, starring in his whimsical stories about sailing into the moon and traveling into the sunset. As [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) grew older, he eventually realized he was outgrowing his fantasies about Nora and his other fairyland characters.

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P41](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0041), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P43](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0043), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P44](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0044), [v3 ch.People P0](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0000), [v3 ch.People P11](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0011), +2 more_

## Relationships

### [Cedric Stanhope](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/cedric-stanhope--nora.md)

Nora is one of the imaginary, whimsical companions created by [Cedric Stanhope](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) in his shore-side fantasies. According to a letter written by [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md), he imagines going on fantastic adventures with her, including sailing into the moon and traveling into the sunset alongside other fictional figures.

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P41](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0041), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P43](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0043), +1 more_
